title: Laboratory Information System Incident Response
description: Laboratory Information System incidents affecting research operations
triggers: Complete LIS outage affecting laboratory operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on research operations and laboratory workflows
Implement manual laboratory procedures if needed
Contact research team for experiment impact assessment
investigation_steps: Review LIS application logs and status
Verify network connectivity to laboratory systems
resolution_steps: Restart LIS services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply LIS patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with LIS vendor for complex issues
verification: Test LIS functionality at affected laboratories
Confirm with research staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Do not delete research data during troubleshooting
Suspected data exposure must immediately involve the security team
Research data integrity is critical for scientific operations
Coordinate with research team for minimal disruption to experiments
